title: TSS_iEEG
description: Intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 7 participants undergoing closed-loop, theta-synchronized stimulation of human hippocampal networks. The dataset accompanies a study showing that closed-loop control of theta oscillations enhances hippocampal network connectivity. Recordings are segmented into pre- and post-stimulation evoked potentials, pre- and post-stimulation rest, closed-loop stimulation, and control stimulation periods.
methods_description: Raw iEEG data were stored in BrainVision format and organized according to the BIDS iEEG specification. Each subject's recordings are divided into stimulation protocol periods (evoked potentials, rest, closed-loop stimulation, control stimulation). Electrode coordinates are provided in MNI space, registered to the MNI152 2009c asymmetrical template.

funding_references.funder_name: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
